implementation: Restore the bounded R30 XYZRHW handlers at the final R34 draw boundary. Each of the four final draw wrappers tries its matching R30TryXyzrhw* handler first and treats every result other than E_NOTIMPL as handled; only an explicit E_NOTIMPL falls through to the unchanged R33 owner. The attempt remains inside R34GuardStereoRasterState so viewport/scissor replay protection still encloses the XYZRHW stereo path. This preserves exact single-draw ownership and prevents R33 from drawing a second time after an R30 handled result.
